viewsWelcome.contents:
No proposal files found (for example, DBIP-001-example.md or ADR-001-example.md).

The ID prefix is controlled by `adrp.idPrefix`; the search pattern is controlled by `adrp.include` (empty uses `**/<prefix>-*.md`). `adrp.exclude` excludes history, output, .archived, and node_modules by default.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22adrp.idPrefix%22)
[Refresh](command:adrp.refresh)
[New proposal](command:adrp.newProposal)

configuration.title: ADR Proposals
configuration.idPrefix.description:
ID prefix, such as `DBIP` (DBIP-001) or `ADR` (ADR-001). Controls file matching, ID parsing, titles, new IDs, and validation. Add other prefixes with `adrp.include`.

Workspace setting: keep this repository convention in `.vscode/settings.json` and commit it for the team.
configuration.titlePrefix.description:
The static view name is `ADR Proposals`; this value appears in the dynamic title after it, for example `ADR Proposals: DBIP`. Empty follows `adrp.idPrefix`.

Workspace setting: keep this repository convention in `.vscode/settings.json`.
configuration.include.description: File globs relative to the workspace root. Empty uses `**/<adrp.idPrefix>-*.md`; add one glob per additional ID prefix.
configuration.statusAliases.description: Map status text used in documents to canonical values, such as Awaiting review to Ready or Shipped to Implemented. Unmapped values appear as Unlabeled.
configuration.lintEnabled.description: Validate open proposal files for title IDs, metadata, statuses, and empty sections. Results appear in the Problems panel.
configuration.plansDir.description: Proposal directory relative to the workspace root, used by New Proposal and Open Proposal Index. Repository convention; set it in workspace settings.
configuration.exclude.description: File and directory globs relative to the workspace root, used to keep history and validation reports out of the proposal list.
configuration.groupByStatus.description: Group proposals by status (Draft, Ready, Implemented, Archived). Display preference; set in user settings.
configuration.showStatusInDescription.de: Show the proposal status after its title. Display preference; set in user settings.
